mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workitem WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND gmt_create >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workitem w JOIN status_node sn ON w.status_node_id = sn.id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.gmt_create >= #{since} AND sn.category = 'DONE'

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, gmt_create, gmt_modified)), 0) FROM dispatch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND gmt_create >= #{since} AND is_deleted = 0 AND agent_id = #{agentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND gmt_create >= #{since}

SELECT DATE(usage_at) as day, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) as tokens FROM dispatch_ai_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND usage_at >= #{since} AND agent_id = #{agentId} GROUP BY DATE(usage_at) ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN agent a ON al.actor_id = a.id AND al.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE al.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND al.gmt_create >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL
7 90 30
DAY)
AND = #{riskLevel}
AND a.id = #{workerId} AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(al.detail_json) THEN al.detail_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.actorType')), 'HUMAN') = 'AGENT'

SELECT a.id, a.name FROM agent a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch d WHERE d.agent_id = a.id AND d.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND d.is_deleted = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_conversation_usage u WHERE u.agent_id = a.id AND u.tenant_id = a.tenant_id) ) ORDER BY a.name

SELECT w.id AS workitemId, w.title, w.work_type AS workType, w.gmt_create AS workitemCreatedAt, e.id AS eventId, e.event_type AS eventType, e.to_val AS toVal, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ASSIGN' AND target_agent.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'AGENT' WHEN e.event_type = 'ASSIGN' AND e.to_val REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN 'HUMAN' ELSE NULL END AS inferredToType, e.detail_json AS detailJson, e.gmt_create AS eventAt, COALESCE(sn.category = 'DONE', FALSE) AS terminal FROM workitem w JOIN workitem_event e ON e.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND e.workitem_id = w.id LEFT JOIN status_node sn ON sn.template_id = w.template_id AND sn.code = e.to_val LEFT JOIN agent target_agent ON e.event_type = 'ASSIGN' AND e.to_val REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND target_agent.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND target_agent.id = CAST(e.to_val AS UNSIGNED) AND target_agent.is_deleted = 0 WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND e.gmt_create < #{cutoffExclusive} AND e.event_type IN ('CREATE', 'ASSIGN', 'STATUS_CHANGE') ORDER BY w.id, e.gmt_create, e.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT DISTINCT w.id FROM workitem w JOIN workitem_event e ON e.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND e.workitem_id = w.id LEFT JOIN status_node sn ON sn.template_id = w.template_id AND sn.code = e.to_val WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND e.gmt_create >= #{startInclusive} AND e.gmt_create < #{endExclusive} AND e.event_type = 'STATUS_CHANGE' AND COALESCE(sn.category = 'DONE', FALSE) ORDER BY w.id
SELECT d.workitem_id AS workitemId, MIN(d.gmt_create) AS firstDispatchAt FROM dispatch d WHERE GROUP BY d.workitem_id

SELECT w.id AS workitemId, w.title, w.work_type AS workType, w.gmt_create AS workitemCreatedAt, e.id AS eventId, e.event_type AS eventType, e.to_val AS toVal, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ASSIGN' AND target_agent.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'AGENT' WHEN e.event_type = 'ASSIGN' AND e.to_val REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN 'HUMAN' ELSE NULL END AS inferredToType, e.detail_json AS detailJson, e.gmt_create AS eventAt, COALESCE(sn.category = 'DONE', FALSE) AS terminal FROM workitem w JOIN workitem_event e ON e.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND e.workitem_id = w.id LEFT JOIN status_node sn ON sn.template_id = w.template_id AND sn.code = e.to_val LEFT JOIN agent target_agent ON e.event_type = 'ASSIGN' AND e.to_val REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND target_agent.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND target_agent.id = CAST(e.to_val AS UNSIGNED) AND target_agent.is_deleted = 0 WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.id IN #{id} AND e.gmt_create < #{cutoffExclusive} AND e.event_type IN ('CREATE', 'ASSIGN', 'STATUS_CHANGE') ORDER BY w.id, e.gmt_create, e.id
